subject: paper:masuch-2019
quote: The sample comprised n = 104 adults with ADHD, of whom n = 24 (23.3%) reported high internalized stigma, n = 92 (88.5%) anticipated discrimination in daily life and n = 70 (69.3%) perceived public stigma.
rationale: Verbatim from the abstract. Prevalence of internalized stigma, anticipated discrimination and perceived public stigma among adults with ADHD.

subject: paper:masuch-2019
